storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
Video Downloader for Mindvalley makes it easy to save videos from Mindvalley.com to your computer for offline learning.

How it works: Navigate to any course lesson, quest video, or masterclass on Mindvalley.com and press play. Click the extension icon in your toolbar. The extension automatically detects the video stream, shows available quality options, and downloads it as a standard MP4 file.

It handles Mindvalley's HLS streaming, tokenized URLs, and multi-platform embeds automatically — no external tools, no command line, no technical knowledge required. Videos save directly to your Downloads folder.

Key features:
- Automatic HLS stream detection from Mindvalley's native player
- Converts HLS streams to standard MP4 files in your browser
- Supports embedded Vimeo, YouTube, Loom, and Wistia videos
- Quality selection from available resolutions
- Real-time download progress with speed indicators
- Download manager with progress tracking
- Clean, professional UI with sky blue accents
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to Mindvalley.com and navigate to a course lesson
3. Press play on the video
4. Click the extension icon and select quality
5. Download — saved as MP4

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How do I download a Mindvalley video?
faq.answer: Go to any course lesson on Mindvalley.com and press play on the video. Then click the extension icon in your toolbar. The extension detects the stream and lets you download it as MP4.

faq.question: What types of Mindvalley content can I download?
faq.answer: Any video content on Mindvalley.com — quest lessons, masterclasses, and other video content. The extension also supports embedded Vimeo, YouTube, Loom, and Wistia videos that appear on Mindvalley pages.

faq.question: Why do I need to press play first?
faq.answer: Mindvalley uses HLS streaming with tokenized URLs. The video stream URL is only available after playback starts. The extension monitors the stream request to capture the correct URL.

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: The extension detects all available qualities from the HLS master playlist. For embedded platforms like Vimeo or YouTube, quality options from those platforms are also available.

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Does this work with Mindvalley's mobile app?
faq.answer: No. This is a desktop browser extension. It works with Mindvalley.com accessed through a desktop browser.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. Video processing happens entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP — no passwords stored. The extension only accesses Mindvalley.com and the embedded video platforms.
